name: Founding partner
tagline: A template you can copy — name, headshot, and work links are all editable in people.json.
bio: Each entry here becomes a public profile at /people/[slug] — a personal portfolio that stays visually tied to the main site: same type, same surface logic, but room for a face and a line of work that is yours, not the studio’s alone.
Add a headshot to public/people/founding.jpg (optional). Duplicate the JSON object in people.json for every collaborator, then wire workSlugs to studio projects they touched.

name: Collaborator slot
tagline: Second profile to show a grid. Replace the copy and add your own slug.
bio: New-era studios are networks: a core team plus people who float in for releases, research, and tools. This block is a placeholder — swap the name, photo, and links when you are ready.
